guesses.reason: Short, ticked brown-gray tabby coat with forehead stripes and a white blaze, muzzle, and chest is the classic random-bred tabby-and-white pattern.
Very large, tall ears set on a slender, wedge-leaning head with a lean build hint at some Oriental-type influence.
The finely ticked, agouti-flecked texture on the body and big ears loosely echo an Abyssinian look.

breed.appearance: A slender, short-haired brown tabby-and-white cat with a finely ticked, salt-and-pepper brown-gray coat on the back and sides, dark tabby stripes on the forehead, and a black-ringed tail. A narrow white blaze runs up the center of the face between the eyes, widening into a white muzzle, chin, and full white chest/bib, with a warm ginger-tan patch on the bridge of the nose above a pink-brick nose. Very large, upright pointed ears with pinkish insides and long white ear tufts, wide pale celery-green eyes outlined in dark rims, and long white whiskers give an alert, slightly wide-eyed expression.
breed.fun_fact: Brown tabby-and-white cats like Gabriel wear one of the oldest coat patterns in feline history, and the classic 'M' on the forehead makes every tabby instantly recognizable!
